column1: # hardev command table: one row per noun + verb. Read by bin/hardev (dispatch, help) and by init.sh --shims hardev.
#   noun verb   `-` = the noun alone (also the row taken when the next word is an option or absent)
#   script      the kernel script exec'd; `-` = built into bin/hardev
#   args        fixed arguments put before the caller's; `-` = none
#   json        yes = the script takes --json (passed through); no = --json is refused (exit 2)
#   lane        env = --lane exports ROTATION_LANE; arg = --lane NAME is passed to the script as arguments
#   root        conf = find the project root and export ROTATION_PROJECT_DIR; cwd = the script finds its own
#               root from the working directory (--project changes into DIR first)
#   legacy      the .claude/rotation/<script> name an `init.sh --shims hardev` shim maps to this row; `-` = none
#   usage       the arguments after noun and verb
